name: hgbeigi-tools

plugins.name: review-gate
plugins.description: A read-only second check, with a reviewer agent, before work is called done.

plugins.name: delegation-kit
plugins.description: How to brief a helper agent, and the shape it hands back in.

plugins.name: session-close
plugins.description: End a session so the next one picks up without the transcript.

plugins.name: check-the-record-first
plugins.description: Search your own files before stating a fact or asking you.

plugins.name: known-limits
